placement.rule: The line's first PROMINENT unit lands on a downbeat; every unit before it takes ONE PULSE of the section's own meter immediately before that downbeat. So `beat` is a count of the line's own upbeat syllables, not a constant. The previous blueprint gave every second line a pickup of 1.5 pulses in all four of its time signatures -- one number, applied to alternate lines regardless of the words -- which cleared DOWNBEAT_LOCKED without any line being heard. That is the error this declaration exists to correct.
placement.dialect: prominence is CMUdict General American with the harness's WEAK_ALWAYS / WEAK_NONFINAL function-word demotion, the same reading `quality/fit.py` reports (doctrine 1: the declaration states its coordinates; doctrine 46: the function-word list is part of the phonology).
placement.returns_inherit: `verse2` takes `verse1`'s placement line for line and `chorus2` takes `chorus`'s, because a return is the same TUNE with new words. Where the return's words carry one more upbeat syllable than the first instance's -- chorus line 4, 'and I held it there' against 'and hold it there' -- they SHARE the pickup rather than moving the slot. The tune slot is the invariant; the words bend.
overrides: Delacroix x3 (bridge): CMUdict's `delacroix` row is `D AH0 L AH0 K R W AH0` -- every syllable stress 0 -- so the rule read the bridge's own proper noun as three unstressed syllables and would have handed it a three-pulse pickup off a defective dictionary row. The author declares DEL-a-croix: first syllable prominent, pickup 0.
placement.what_the_check_says: 28 of the 31 off-downbeat lines take a one-pulse pickup, so `uniformity()['uniform_anacrusis']` reads 0.90 and UNIFORM_ANACRUSIS FIRES on this blueprint. That is reported, not tuned away: the uniformity is now a property of English line-openings -- 28 of these 41 lines begin with exactly one weak syllable -- rather than of a constant somebody added. See `grid.uniformity` for what the check can and cannot separate (doctrine 17).
placement.groups: `chorus`/`chorus2` declare 4/4 as (2,2) and `outro` declares 3/4 as (3). These are AUTHORIAL DECISIONS, not measurements and not `conventional_grouping()`, which doctrine 19 forbids consulting: (2,2) is declared because the chorus's own stresses fall on 1 and 3 -- 'So SAY the road. SAY it slow' -- and 4/4 admits eight orderings of which [2,2] and [4] are different meters; (3) is declared because the outro's single line is one gesture per bar and nothing subdivides it. Declaring them ends 17 refusals and BUYS a finding: at (2,2) a 4-pulse span covers two heads, and every chorus line has more prominent syllables than that.
placement.numerals: 'Tonight it is County Road 6' keeps its numeral and the numeral is REFUSED, so the line's count is a LOWER BOUND (doctrine 79). It is not expanded to 'six': expansion is a per-PHONOLOGY reading, not a default -- `ltc` already reads the character numeral 十 as a syllable because its rime table has a row for it, while English has no reading for '6' at all, and a single expansion rule would be an English decision applied to nine phonologies (doctrine 45).

lines.text: The scanner warms before the room does
The chair still holds the last one's heat
Nine miles of gravel on the whiteboard
Three of them are named for men
I know this county by its mailboxes
by which dogs are out, by which bridge floods
I have worked here nineteen winters
I have never once been to a scene
There's a half second after the tone
where nobody has said anything yet
and the whole thing could still be a wrong number
a kid, a fax machine, a bad connect
So say the road. Say it slow
I will find you on line five
I will put my voice inside your ear
and hold it there while you drive
I don't get to go
I don't get to see how it went
I hang up and I wipe the screen clear
and the console clears. Next one sent
Tonight it is County Road 6
the Vaughn place, past the second cattle guard
I have driven by that mailbox
maybe four thousand times
His wife is on the line and she is not crying
which is the part that nobody warns you of
how the calm ones are the worst ones
how they read the address like a receipt
Delacroix says you cannot carry them
Delacroix keeps a boat
Delacroix has never held a line
open for eleven minutes
So say the road. Say it slow
I did find you on line five
I did put my voice inside your ear
and I held it there. You were alive
I don't get to go
I don't get to see how it went
I hang up and I wipe the screen clear
and the console clears. Nothing sent
The pot is down to tar
